question: Where can I get a list of active mines and quarries in Germany, with location, mineral or rock extracted, operator and annual production?

answer.summary: No nationwide public register of active mines and quarries was found. Hessen, Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg, Brandenburg and some Lower Rhine districts publish site records with varying attributes and status definitions. Hessen’s 276 records include a planned site and provide operators and output classes. No annual production figures per site were verified.
main_caveats: 'Active' differs by source: BW 'in Betrieb' layer includes 'Abbau ruht' and 'in Herrichtung'; Saxony MR.Mine 'operating' covers closure plans (Abschlussbetriebsplan); BY status is from the last aerial photo.
Mining-authority layers cover only BBergG sites; most gravel, sand, limestone and natural-stone quarries fall under Land/district permits and appear only in geological-survey or district layers.

The sources checked did not provide actual annual production per site. Hessen provides output classes without a reference year. USGS capacity and planned extraction in permits describe different measures.
BGR KOR250 'Abbaustelle' points are from map sheets of 1989-2024 and often mark the company seat; BSK1000 still shows mines closed by 2018.
Coverage is uneven: structured site layers were found for 5 of 16 Länder plus 3 NRW districts; national aggregates (BGR, SdK) are not site lists.
answer.confidence_reason: Each Land checked with services queried; MV and Sachsen-Anhalt could not be inspected, city-states not checked, and GEM/OSM could not be tested from this environment.

attributes.note: Exact points/polygons for active sites in BW, BY, HE, BB, SN (mining plans) and 3 NRW districts; KOR250 national points are 1989-2024 map vintages.
attributes.gap_note: No public site layer found for NI (PDF map only), RP, TH, SH, SL or most of NRW; Sachsen-Anhalt portal returns 403 to automated clients and the MV map portal did not respond.

attributes.note: Raw material per active site in BW (Rohstoff), BY (rohst_rgs), HE (ROHSTOFF), BB (bodenschatz), NRW districts; Saxony MR.Mine has none.
attributes.gap_note: Same Länder gaps as location; mining-rights layers (NI LBEG, RP LGB) give licensed commodities, not extraction.

attributes.note: Operator field only in Hessen (FIRMA, 276/276), Brandenburg (unternehmer, 241/241) and KRZN NRW districts (FIRMA); USGS names operators of major facilities.
attributes.gap_note: No operator field in BW, BY, Saxony MR.Mine or KOR250 layers checked; LBEG company directory (2016) links firms to districts, not sites.

attributes.note: Only Hessen publishes a per-site output class (e.g. '> 50.000 — 250.000 t/a', year not stated); GEM's lignite mine output could not be tested.
attributes.gap_note: BBergG operators report Rohförderung per Betrieb to mining authorities (§§ 67, 70) and Destatis keeps Einzelangaben secret (§ 16 BStatG); only Land/national totals are published.

sources.name: Länder extraction-site inventories (Rohstoffgewinnungsstellen / Abbaustellen)
sources.publisher: State geological surveys (LGRB BW, LfU Bayern, HLNUG Hessen, others) and NRW district permit authorities via KRZN
sources.format: ArcGIS REST JSON/GeoJSON (HE), OGC WFS GML (BW, KRZN), GeoPackage (BY), WMS (BY)
sources.license: Varies: CC BY 4.0 (BY), Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero 2.0 (KRZN), © HLNUG with no licence stated (HE), LGRB AGB (BW)
sources.summary: Regional extraction-site layers include Hessen (276 records, including a planned site), Bavaria (1,299 records) and Baden-Württemberg (545 records). The status categories differ by dataset.
sources.coverage_note: Structured data for BW, BY, HE and NRW districts Kleve, Viersen, Wesel; NI only a PDF map; none found for RP, TH, SH, SL; ST and MV not inspectable.
sources.data_date: BY photo years 2014-2025; BW documentation October 2025; HE undated
caveats: Each Land defines 'active' differently (BW includes paused sites).
Operator only in Hessen and NRW districts; production only as Hessen output classes.

problems: Coverage limited to the Länder and districts listed as members; no national harmonisation.
Hessen and LGRB services state no open licence in their capabilities.

members_summary.scope_note: 16 Länder; 13 listed (Brandenburg covered by mining_authority_registers; Berlin, Hamburg, Bremen not checked). Structured active-site data found in 4 (BW, BY, HE, part of NRW); 2 could not be inspected (ST blocked, MV not responding).
members_summary.pattern: Look on the Land geological survey's geodata page for 'Rohstoffgewinnungsstellen', 'Abbaustellen' or 'Gewinnungsstellen' layers, or in district (Kreis) 'Abgrabungen' services; GovData search for these terms finds some.

sources.name: Mining-authority (Bergbehörde) layers of establishments and operating plans under the Federal Mining Act
sources.publisher: Mining authorities of the Länder (e.g. LBGR Brandenburg, Sächsisches Oberbergamt)
sources.format: OGC WFS 2.0 GML (Brandenburg), WMS with GetFeatureInfo (Sachsen)
sources.summary: Brandenburg's LBGR WFS lists 241 mining establishments with operator and mineral, joinable to valid main operating plans (129); Sachsen publishes mine-plan polygons via WMS.
sources.coverage_note: Only BBergG sites; complete for Brandenburg, WMS-only for Sachsen; other Länder publish rights maps instead.
caveats: 'operating' in INSPIRE MR.Mine includes closure plans.
Excludes most quarries permitted under non-mining law.

problems: Sachsen WFS listed in metadata (iwfs_gsz_mineralische-bodenschaetze) returns HTTP 404; only the WMS works.

members_summary.scope_note: One mining authority per Land (some shared: LBEG also for HH, HB, SH; LBGR also for Berlin). 7 listed and tested; establishments with operator found in Brandenburg, mine status without operator in Sachsen; others publish rights or overlap layers.
members_summary.pattern: Search the Land mining authority's INSPIRE 'Bergbau' or 'Mineralische Bodenschätze' services for Betriebsstätten or Betriebsplan layers; Berechtsamskarten show rights only.

sources.name: KOR250 – Karte der oberflächennahen Rohstoffe 1:250.000, layer 'Abbaustelle'
sources.publisher: Bundesanstalt für Geowissenschaften und Rohstoffe (BGR) with the State Geological Surveys
sources.format: ArcGIS REST MapServer (JSON/GeoJSON attributes; map images)
sources.summary: National BGR layer of 4,301 extraction-site points with raw material and map-sheet year; points can be viewed but the query service returns no coordinates.
sources.coverage_note: All Länder, but most points date from 1989-2010 map sheets and may mark company seats.
caveats: Not a current list of active sites.

problems: Query service returns geometry null for all features.
No licence stated in the service description.

sources.name: USGS Minerals Yearbook 2024 – Germany, Facilities table
sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey, National Minerals Information Center
sources.format: PDF (tables also as XLSX releases for earlier years)
sources.summary: Annual USGS chapter with a facilities table naming operator, facility, municipality and capacity for Germany's major mines and plants.
sources.coverage_note: Major facilities only; location at municipality level; capacity, not production.

problems: www.usgs.gov landing page returns 403 to curl; reachable with another client.

if_unstructured.summary: Per-site production and, outside a few Länder, operator and location must be taken from documents: mining-authority annual reports, BGR commodity studies, operator websites and permit files.

local_terms.meaning: Extraction site; name of the geological-survey site layers (BW, BY, SN).
Extraction site; Hessen and KOR250 layer name.
Excavation permitted outside mining law (NRW district layers, Abgrabungsmonitoring).
Mining establishment under mining supervision (Brandenburg, Sachsen).
Main operating plan (active) vs closure plan; used to tell active from closing sites.
Output class / extracted quantity (Hessen field; mining-authority statistics).
Federal Mining Act; defines which sites fall under mining authorities.
